plan.notes: SOURCE: official NECC Academic Catalog, 2024-2025 Updated edition (Effective Spring 2025), program page 'Computer and Information Sciences: Computer Science, Associate in Science' at https://necc.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025-updated/catalog/academic-programs/computer-and-information-sciences/associate-degrees/computer-and-information-sciences-computer-science-associate-in-science . TRUE PROGRAM NAME per catalog: 'Computer and Information Sciences: Computer Science, Associate in Science' (AS degree). TRANSCRIPTION METHOD: the catalog's 'Recommended Course Sequence/Pathway Transfer Concentration' table was transcribed course-by-course on 2026-09-30; titles and credit hours copied verbatim from the official table. CONCENTRATION CAVEAT: the program requires students to choose ONE of two concentrations (Transfer or Web Development); this plan follows the Transfer Concentration pathway, which is also the sequence shown on the current official program page at necc.mass.edu/academics/credit-programs/computer-information-science/computer-science-associate-degree/ (crawled 2026-09, identical course tables). TOTAL-CREDITS HONESTY: catalog prints 'Total Credit Hours: 60' and 'A minimum of 60 credits is required for graduation'; the four Program Elective slots are officially 3-4 credits each (catalog: choose 3-4 courses totaling at least 12 credits). This file uses the 3-credit minimum per elective so the sum equals the catalog's printed 60; a student taking 4-credit electives would graduate with 60-64 credits. PREREQ HONESTY: the catalog flags CIS113, CIS115, CIS154, CIS160, CIS225, CIS252, ENG102, MAT251, MAT252 as 'courses with prerequisites' and MAT251, MAT252, CIS160, CIS252 as milestone courses, but does not publish the specific prerequisite chains on the program page, so prereq lists are intentionally left empty rather than invented. Schedule tips (CIS252 offered FALL ONLY) carried from catalog. No placement/assessment gate stated for this program.
